blocks.text: JavaScript JSON Stringify
The JSON.stringify() Method
The JSON.stringify() method converts a JavaScript value into JSON text.
JavaScript variables must be converted to plain text before they can be:

items: Sent to a server over HTTP

blocks.text: Note
The JSON.stringify() method returns a text string.
JSON.stringify(value, replacer, space)

blocks.text: Stringifying Dates
The JSON.stringify() function will convert Date objects into strings.

const person = {name:"John", today:date, city:"New York"};

let text = JSON.stringify(person);
blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text: You can convert the string back into a date object at the receiver.
Storing Data

When storing data, the data has to be a certain format, and regardless of where you choose to store it,
text is always one of the legal formats.
JSON makes it possible to store JavaScript objects as text.
